properties.name: When a writing --call keeps no export, its line names every place the export could have been named, built from the same list the lookup reads, .reflow2.toml first
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-19 (field limitation 22, VS Code --call run on 0.87.0)
properties.statement: When a writing --call finds no export to keep current, the line it prints names every source call_export::find reads, in the order it reads them, and is generated from that same list: first the exact file <project>/.reflow2.toml with [export] path = "…" (the record that persists for later writes, the Stop hook, init and the gate), then --export-to <FILE> for one call, then the MCP configurations. A source added to the lookup without appearing in the line fails a test.
